market_summary: The New York session presents pervasive bearish pressure across indices, FX, metals, and crypto, with price action across all assets trading below their respective session VWAP and EMA50 baselines. However, current setups are either extended beyond -2 ATR envelopes (US100, EURUSD), resting directly on key dealer Put Walls and Value Area Lows (XAUUSD), or printing low-volume sweeps at Session Lows (GBPUSD, XAGUSD, BTCUSD). Strict confluence criteria require holding flat to avoid chasing late-stage momentum into major structural liquidity pockets.

signals.rationale: In the NEW_YORK_SESSION, price is inside the Value Area (VAL 3876.49 to VAH 3904.17) and trading below POC 3894.76. Trend is below VWAP (3895.37) and below EMA50 (3891.80). CVD is -4.71 with a BEARISH label and negative slope (-0.83), agreeing with broader session weakness. Price is resting near the lower ATR band (3867.56). Volume is normal with RVOL at 1.265 (no yellow confirmation spike). The signal candle swept Session Low (3867.64) before rebounding. Crucially, GEX indicates a NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING regime below the Gamma Flip (3884.55), but live price sits directly on Put Wall #1 (3876.47), where dealer hedging provides strong support. Per GEX execution rules, selling directly into Put Wall #1 without room to scalp is prohibited, while buying counter-trend is unjustified.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish below declining session VWAP and EMA baselines
signals.level_event: sweep of Session Low 3867.64 and test of Put Wall 3876.47
